data.narrative:
Rune Technologies is a Series A defense and security company founded by David Tuttle and Peter Goldsborough, having raised $20M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $20M raised as a proxy base and applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next stage, implying a $40M valuation. The peer-median method anchors to 11 comparable companies in Defense & Security, which exhibit a median valuation of $1.0B with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. Named peers at later stage include Dream Security ($3.0B, Series B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B, Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B, Series B), and Code Metal ($1.2B, Series B).

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $34M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $520M. The stage-progression method anchors the floor, while the peer-median approach defines the ceiling. The substantial width of this range reflects genuine uncertainty around Rune's competitive position, technology maturity, and market traction relative to the peer set. Further diligence on revenue, customer concentration, and product-market fit would be required to narrow positioning within this band.
